alt: Table of three bands of cells by female share, showing the number of cells, their share of workers, their share of the regression's implicit weight, and their average gender contrast; mixed cells gain weight and segregated cells lose it, while the average contrast differs little between the first two bands.
note: Implicit weight of a cell = N_c p_c (1 − p_c) with p_c the cell's PERWT-weighted female share.
source: IPUMS USA, ACS 2024 1-year (SAMPLE 202401), analysis/usa/acs/part_2020_2024.parquet; replicate weights REPWTP1–80 from analysis/usa/acs_repwt/part_2020_2024.parquet
subtitle: Cells grouped by their female share; contrasts are population-share averages within the band
title: Where the gender regression's weight goes
